content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for RBI Bank's Medical Consultant Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: https://opportunities.rbi.org.in/Scripts/Vacancies.aspx. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 16-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant position is 16th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the required qualification for the Bank's Medical Consultant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MBBS degree recognized by the Medical Council of India. A minimum of 2 years of post-qualification experience as a Registered Medical Practitioner is mandatory. A postgraduate degree in General Medicine is preferred.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is offline. You need to download the application form from the official website, fill it out carefully, and send it to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Bank's Medical Consultant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will be compensated at a rate of ₹1,000/- per hour for their services as a Bank's Medical Consultant.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee required for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) to apply for the RBI Bank's Medical Consultant recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the total number of vacancies available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the post of Bank's Medical Consultant in the Reserve Bank of India.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Bank's Medical Consultant position will involve an Interview, followed by Document Verification, and Medical Tests.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location?
faq.answer: The job is located in Panaji, Goa, with the pincode 403001.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The position of Bank's Medical Consultant is on a contract basis.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply through online mode?
faq.answer: No, the application mode for this recruitment is strictly offline. You must submit a physical application form as per the instructions in the official notification.
